blocks.zh: 技術移轉流程架構與管理監督
blocks.en: Technology Transfer Process Framework and Management Oversight

blocks.zh: 本節內容 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 法規觀點：「有文件」才算有制度
blocks.en: Regulatory Perspective: A System Exists Only If It Is Documented

blocks.zh: TR65 開宗明義：監管機關期望的是「有文件的 TT 流程」，而不只是靠慣例行事。這意味著你的 TT SOP 必須明確描述每個步驟的要求，並且每次 TT 都要留下執行記錄。FDA/EMA 查廠時，這是必查項目。
blocks.en: TR65 makes the point at the outset: regulators expect a documented TT process, not one that relies on habit. Your TT SOP must therefore describe the requirements of each step, and every TT must leave an execution record. FDA and EMA inspectors always check this during site inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻：六個階段像火箭發射倒數
blocks.en: Analogy: The Six Stages Are Like a Rocket Launch Countdown

blocks.zh: 每個 Stage Gate 就像火箭發射前的倒數確認（T-10, T-5...）。任何一個子系統未就緒，發射指揮官（Steering Committee）就暫停倒數。不是懲罰，是確保安全。Stage Gate 的精神是「不帶著問題進入下一階段」。
blocks.en: Each Stage Gate is like a pre-launch countdown check (T-10, T-5...). If any subsystem is not ready, the launch director (the Steering Committee) holds the countdown. This is not a penalty; it is how safety is ensured. The spirit of a Stage Gate is to never carry open problems into the next stage.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：階段可以並行，但 Gate 不能跳過
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Stages Can Run in Parallel, but Gates Cannot Be Skipped

blocks.zh: TR65 明確指出，TT 活動常因商業壓力而跨階段並行（例如，知識移轉還沒完成，就開始準備設備確認）。這是現實，可以接受。但 Stage Gate 的正式批准不能省略——即使活動並行，每個 Gate 的文件審核仍必須完整。
blocks.en: TR65 states clearly that TT activities often overlap across stages because of commercial pressure (for example, equipment qualification preparation starts before knowledge transfer is complete). This is the reality and is acceptable. However, formal approval at each Stage Gate cannot be omitted: even when activities run in parallel, the document review at every Gate must still be complete.

blocks.zh: 思考問題
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: 您的公司目前有沒有正式的 TT 流程 SOP？它是否覆蓋了這六個階段？Stage Gate 的審核是由誰執行？有無否決權？
blocks.en: Does your company currently have a formal TT process SOP? Does it cover all six stages? Who performs the Stage Gate review, and do they have veto power?

blocks.zh: 九個功能部門：誰最容易被遺漏？
blocks.en: Nine Functional Areas: Which Is Most Easily Overlooked?

blocks.zh: TT 中最常被輕忽的三個部門：
blocks.en: The three functional areas most often neglected in TT:

blocks.zh: Business（商業）：許多 TT 只有技術團隊參與，沒有財務/法務/銷售代表。但目標市場、預算、智財權問題都需要在 Initiation 階段就釐清。
blocks.en: Business: Many TTs involve only the technical team, with no finance, legal or sales representatives. Yet the target market, budget and intellectual property issues all need to be clarified at the Initiation stage.

blocks.zh: Sourcing/Supply Chain（採購/供鏈）：原料來源和包材在新廠是否可及？物流規劃是否納入？常常到 Readiness 階段才發現原料採購有問題。
blocks.en: Sourcing/Supply Chain: Are the raw materials and packaging materials available at the new site? Has logistics planning been included? Problems with raw material sourcing are often discovered only at the Readiness stage.

blocks.zh: Regulatory（法規）：特別在 External TT 中，兩廠可能鎖定不同市場，法規申報策略需早期對齊，否則 PPQ 批次數量都可能選錯。
blocks.en: Regulatory: Particularly in External TT, the two sites may target different markets, so regulatory filing strategies need to be aligned early. Otherwise even the number of PPQ batches may be chosen wrongly.

blocks.zh: TT PM 的特殊要求
blocks.en: Special Requirements for the TT PM

blocks.zh: TR65 對 TT PM 的描述值得注意：需要「跨功能的基本技術知識 + CMC 知識」。這不是普通的專案管理師，而是需要懂技術的人。
blocks.en: TR65's description of the TT PM is worth noting: the role requires "cross-functional basic technical knowledge + CMC knowledge". This is not an ordinary project manager; it must be someone who understands the technology.

blocks.zh: 在 External-External TT 中，TT PM 可能由 MAH 出任，而非 RU（CDMO）。這對 CDMO 意味著：你的 PM 在某些情況下不是「最後的仲裁者」，MAH 的 TT PM 才是主導決策的人。
blocks.en: In an External-External TT, the TT PM may come from the MAH rather than the RU (the CDMO). For a CDMO this means that, in some cases, your PM is not the "final arbiter"; the MAH's TT PM is the one who leads decisions.

blocks.zh: 比喻：TT 團隊像奧運轉播團隊
blocks.en: Analogy: The TT Team Is Like an Olympic Broadcast Crew

blocks.zh: 奧運轉播需要導演（TT PM）、攝影師（Process/Engineering）、解說員（Regulatory/QA）、技術支援（Analytical）、行政後勤（Supply Chain）全部到位。缺任何一個，轉播就會出問題。TT 團隊也是如此——缺一個功能代表，那個環節的問題就沒有人負責。
blocks.en: An Olympic broadcast needs a director (TT PM), camera operators (Process/Engineering), commentators (Regulatory/QA), technical support (Analytical) and logistics (Supply Chain), all in place. If any one is missing, the broadcast runs into trouble. The same applies to a TT team: if one functional representative is missing, no one is responsible for the problems in that area.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：TT 協議書的必要條款
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Essential Clauses of the TT Agreement

blocks.zh: TR65 強調「TT agreement」必須列明各廠各功能的責任分工。對 CDMO 而言，這份協議書（通常是 Technical Transfer Agreement 的一部分）至少應明確：
blocks.en: TR65 stresses that the "TT agreement" must set out the division of responsibilities for each function at each site. For a CDMO, this agreement (usually part of a Technical Transfer Agreement) should clearly specify at least the following:

blocks.zh: SU 需提供哪些技術文件（和時限）
blocks.en: Which technical documents the SU must provide (and the deadlines)

blocks.zh: SU SME 到 RU 現場支援的天數和費用
blocks.en: The number of days and the cost of SU SME on-site support at the RU

blocks.zh: 測量單位標準（避免公制/英制混用造成錯誤）
blocks.en: Standard units of measurement (to avoid errors from mixing metric and imperial units)

blocks.zh: 每個功能部門在每個階段的決策角色
blocks.en: The decision-making role of each functional area at each stage

blocks.zh: 在您的 TT 組織中，9 個功能部門是否都有指定聯絡窗口？TT PM 是哪個廠的人？在 External TT 中，如果客戶（SU）的技術人員不願意到 CDMO（RU）廠現場支援，這個問題應在哪個環節提出？
blocks.en: In your TT organization, does each of the 9 functional areas have a designated point of contact? Which site does the TT PM come from? In an External TT, if the customer's (SU's) technical staff are unwilling to support the CDMO (RU) site on-site, at which point should this issue be raised?

blocks.zh: 重要原則：重大變化不等 Gate，立即上報
blocks.en: Key Principle: Significant Changes Are Escalated Immediately, Not Held for the Gate

blocks.zh: TR65 特別強調：如果 TT 團隊在某個階段發現任何可能改變 TT 邊界或假設的資訊，不要等到 Stage Gate 才報告，應立即上報 Steering Committee。這是避免「問題雪球滾到 Gate 才爆發」的關鍵原則。
blocks.en: TR65 specifically stresses that if the TT team discovers, at any stage, information that could change the TT boundaries or assumptions, do not wait until the Stage Gate to report it; escalate it to the Steering Committee immediately. This is the key principle for preventing problems from snowballing until they explode at the Gate.

blocks.zh: 實務警示：許多 TT 失敗案例，都源於團隊知道問題但選擇「看看之後能不能解決再說」，最終延誤了整個計畫。
blocks.en: Practical warning: many failed TTs trace back to a team that knew about a problem but chose to "see if it can be solved later", ultimately delaying the entire project.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Steering Committee = 飛機駕駛艙
blocks.en: Analogy: The Steering Committee Is the Cockpit

blocks.zh: TT 團隊是機艙服務員（執行任務），TT PM 是副駕駛（管理協調），Steering Committee 是機長（決策），Project Sponsor 是航空公司 CEO（最終責任）。如果機身異常震動（TT 發現重大問題），副駕駛要立刻告知機長，而不是等到「下降高度前的例行報告」。
blocks.en: The TT team is the cabin crew (carrying out tasks), the TT PM is the co-pilot (management and coordination), the Steering Committee is the captain (decision-making), and the Project Sponsor is the airline CEO (ultimate accountability). If the aircraft begins to vibrate abnormally (the TT finds a major problem), the co-pilot must tell the captain immediately, not wait for the routine report before descent.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的雙重身份挑戰
blocks.en: The CDMO's Dual-Role Challenge

blocks.zh: 在 Internal-External TT 中，CDMO 通常是 RU，派員加入 Steering Committee 代表 RU 的利益。但 CDMO 同時也要對客戶（MAH/SU）負責。這種「服務提供者 + Steering Committee 成員」的雙重身份，有時會產生衝突：當客戶要求跳過某個 Gate，CDMO 的 Steering Committee 代表應該如何回應？答案是：以 GMP 合規為底線，不得讓步。
blocks.en: In an Internal-External TT, the CDMO is usually the RU and sends a representative to the Steering Committee to represent the RU's interests. But the CDMO is also accountable to its customer (the MAH/SU). This dual role of "service provider + Steering Committee member" can sometimes create conflict: when the customer asks to skip a Gate, how should the CDMO's Steering Committee representative respond? The answer: GMP compliance is the bottom line and cannot be compromised.

blocks.zh: 您的公司在 TT 中是否有正式的 Steering Committee 組成規範？誰有「否決進入下一階段」的權力？如果客戶（SU/MAH）的代表主導了所有決策，RU 廠（CDMO）的聲音是否被聽見？
blocks.en: Does your company have a formal rule on Steering Committee composition for TT? Who has the power to veto progression to the next stage? If the customer's (SU/MAH) representatives drive all decisions, is the voice of the RU site (the CDMO) being heard?

blocks.zh: TT Charter：TT 的「憲法」
blocks.en: TT Charter: The "Constitution" of the TT

blocks.zh: Charter 是 TT 的基本法——所有決策都要回到 Charter 的框架內。它的功能不只是計畫書，更是：
blocks.en: The Charter is the basic law of the TT: all decisions must stay within its framework. It is more than a plan; it also serves as:

blocks.zh: 對齊工具：確保 SU、RU、MAH 對「完成標準」有共識
blocks.en: An alignment tool: ensures that the SU, RU and MAH share the same understanding of the completion criteria

blocks.zh: 防爭議文件：當各方對範圍有分歧時，回到 Charter 解決
blocks.en: A dispute-prevention document: when the parties disagree on scope, return to the Charter to resolve it

blocks.zh: 變更管理基線：Planning 後的任何 Charter 變更，必須 Steering Committee 批准
blocks.en: A change management baseline: any change to the Charter after Planning must be approved by the Steering Committee

blocks.zh: 成功因素 vs. KPI：不要混淆
blocks.en: Success Factors vs. KPIs: Do Not Confuse Them

blocks.zh: 成功因素（Success Factors）是 TT 的「完成標準」，是 TT 是否可以宣告成功的判準。它不等於 KPI（績效指標）。例如：
blocks.en: Success Factors are the "completion criteria" of the TT, the yardstick for deciding whether the TT can be declared successful. They are not the same as KPIs (key performance indicators). For example:

blocks.zh: 成功因素：「PPQ 三批次一次通過」
blocks.en: Success factor: "Three PPQ batches pass on the first attempt"

blocks.zh: KPI：「每批次 OEE 達到 80%」
blocks.en: KPI: "OEE of 80% for each batch"

blocks.zh: 成功因素要在 Charter 中明文定義，並且雙方（SU 和 RU）都要同意。如果沒有事先定義，TT 結束時就會各說各話。
blocks.en: Success factors must be explicitly defined in the Charter, and both parties (SU and RU) must agree to them. If they are not defined in advance, each side will tell a different story when the TT ends.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Charter 是「婚前協議書」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Charter Is a "Prenuptial Agreement"

blocks.zh: Charter 就像婚前協議：在關係正式開始前，雙方白紙黑字同意各自的責任、期望和完成標準。感情好的時候不需要，但一旦有爭議，就是最重要的法律文件。TT 中的 Charter 也是如此——業務順利時沒人看，但出問題時每個字都很重要。
blocks.en: The Charter is like a prenuptial agreement: before the relationship formally begins, both sides agree in writing on their responsibilities, expectations and completion criteria. When things are going well it is not needed, but once there is a dispute it becomes the most important legal document. The same is true of a TT Charter: nobody looks at it when business runs smoothly, but when problems arise every word matters.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見缺漏：Charter 沒有定義「結束點」
blocks.en: Common CDMO Gap: The Charter Does Not Define the "End Point"

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 的 TT 專案因為 Charter 沒有清楚定義「完成即結束」，導致：
blocks.en: In many CDMO TT projects, the Charter does not clearly define that "completion means the end", which leads to:

blocks.zh: 客戶要求 TT 團隊繼續支援第 4、5 批商業生產
blocks.en: The customer asking the TT team to keep supporting the 4th and 5th commercial production batches

blocks.zh: TT 與正式商業生產的費用邊界不清
blocks.en: An unclear cost boundary between TT and formal commercial production

blocks.zh: 哪些「製程調整」算 TT 範圍、哪些算 post-TT 變更管理，無從界定
blocks.en: No way to determine which "process adjustments" fall within TT scope and which belong to post-TT change management

blocks.zh: 解決方案：Charter 中明確寫明「Handover 後，TT 正式結束，後續事宜移交 Commercial Operations 團隊處理」。
blocks.en: Solution: state explicitly in the Charter that "after Handover, the TT formally ends, and follow-up matters are transferred to the Commercial Operations team".

blocks.zh: 在您最近的 TT 中，是否有書面的 Charter？它是否包含所有 TR65 列出的 11 個要素？成功因素是否和客戶雙方確認過？如果現在重新簽一份 Charter，您會加入哪些條款？
blocks.en: In your most recent TT, was there a written Charter? Did it include all 11 elements listed in TR65? Were the success factors confirmed with the customer on both sides? If you were to sign a new Charter today, what clauses would you add?

blocks.zh: Reference Guide 的實際用法
blocks.en: Practical Use of the Reference Guide

blocks.zh: 這個矩陣是 TR65 最具操作性的工具。正確的使用方式：
blocks.en: This matrix is the most operational tool in TR65. The correct ways to use it:

blocks.zh: 啟動 TT 時：以矩陣為藍圖，識別所有活動和交付物
blocks.en: When starting a TT: use the matrix as a blueprint to identify all activities and deliverables

blocks.zh: Stage Gate 前：對照矩陣確認該功能的所有交付物是否完成
blocks.en: Before a Stage Gate: check against the matrix that all deliverables for each function are complete

blocks.zh: 資源規劃時：以矩陣每格的工作量估算各部門需要的人力
blocks.en: During resource planning: use the workload of each cell in the matrix to estimate the manpower each department needs

blocks.zh: 問責追蹤時：每格對應一個主責部門，避免「空格沒人管」
blocks.en: During accountability tracking: each cell maps to one responsible department, so that no "empty cell" is left without an owner

blocks.zh: 關鍵句：所有部門必須「交叉並行」
blocks.en: Key Sentence: All Functions Must "Intersect and Work in Parallel"

blocks.zh: TR65 強調「all functional areas must intersect and work in parallel」——這一句話否定了很多公司的「線性 TT 模式」（Process 部門先完成，Analytical 才開始，Engineering 再跟進）。正確做法是並行啟動，並且各部門之間要有交叉協作（例如，Process 和 Analytical 要一起評估在制控制的樣品計畫）。
blocks.en: TR65 stresses that "all functional areas must intersect and work in parallel". This one sentence rejects the "linear TT model" used by many companies (Process finishes first, then Analytical starts, then Engineering follows). The correct approach is to start in parallel, with cross-collaboration between departments (for example, Process and Analytical should jointly evaluate the sampling plan for in-process controls).

blocks.zh: 比喻：矩陣像電影劇本分場表
blocks.en: Analogy: The Matrix Is Like a Film Shooting Schedule

blocks.zh: 電影劇本分場表列出每個場景需要哪些演員、道具、場地。Reference Guide 就是 TT 的「拍攝計畫表」——每個階段（場景）需要哪個部門（演員）做什麼事（台詞/動作）。導演（TT PM）依此排程，確保每個人在對的時間點到位。
blocks.en: A film shooting schedule lists which actors, props and locations each scene needs. The Reference Guide is the TT's "shooting plan": each stage (scene) shows which department (actor) does what (lines/actions). The director (TT PM) schedules accordingly, making sure everyone is in place at the right time.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：矩陣幫助報價更準確
blocks.en: CDMO Application: The Matrix Helps Produce More Accurate Quotations

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Reference Guide 矩陣還有一個重要用途：協助 TT 報價。每一格代表一個工作量，可以換算成人天數。透過估算矩陣中每格的人天，可以得出更準確的 TT 費用估算，避免低報或高估。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the Reference Guide matrix has another important use: supporting the TT quotation. Each cell represents a workload that can be converted into person-days. Estimating the person-days of each cell in the matrix gives a more accurate TT cost estimate and avoids under- or over-quoting.

blocks.zh: 在您的 TT 作業中，是否有類似矩陣的工具來追蹤各部門在各階段的交付物？如果沒有，TR65 的 Reference Guide 格式是否可以直接導入您的 TT 管理系統？哪個部門的格子最常是空白的？
blocks.en: In your TT operations, do you have a matrix-like tool for tracking each department's deliverables at each stage? If not, could the TR65 Reference Guide format be adopted directly into your TT management system? Which department's cells are most often left blank?

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核心學習要點
blocks.en: Core Learning Points

blocks.zh: Section 1 的四個核心洞察
blocks.en: Four Key Insights from Section 1

blocks.zh: Stage Gate = 有否決權的關卡：不是例行報告，是正式的「繼續/暫停」決策。問題要早報，不要等 Gate。
blocks.en: Stage Gate = a checkpoint with veto power: it is not a routine report but a formal "proceed/hold" decision. Report problems early; do not wait for the Gate.

blocks.zh: 九個功能缺一不可：特別是 Business 和 Supply Chain，容易被技術導向的 TT 團隊遺漏，但往往是延誤的根源。
blocks.en: All nine functional areas are indispensable: Business and Supply Chain in particular are easily overlooked by technically oriented TT teams, yet they are often the root of delays.

blocks.zh: Charter 是防爭議的憲法：成功因素要在開始前定義，「完成即結束」的條款尤其重要。
blocks.en: The Charter is the constitution that prevents disputes: success factors must be defined before the start, and the clause that "completion means the end" is especially important.

blocks.zh: 並行不是混亂，是效率：Reference Guide 設計為各部門並行運作，PM 的任務是協調交叉點，而非串行管理。
blocks.en: Parallel is not chaos; it is efficiency: the Reference Guide is designed for functions to work in parallel, and the PM's task is to coordinate the intersection points rather than manage serially.

blocks.zh: 下一節預告
blocks.en: Preview of the Next Section

blocks.zh: 後續 Sections 將依照六個階段，逐一展開 Reference Guide 矩陣的詳細內容：
blocks.en: The following Sections will go through the six stages and expand the details of the Reference Guide matrix one by one:

blocks.zh: Stage 1 Initiation：RU 評選、風險評估、TT 協議
blocks.en: Stage 1 Initiation: RU selection, risk assessment, TT agreement

blocks.zh: Stage 2 Planning：Charter 細化、時程規劃、KT 計畫
blocks.en: Stage 2 Planning: Charter detailing, schedule planning, KT plan

blocks.zh: Stage 3 Knowledge Transfer：技術套件、製程文件、分析方法
blocks.en: Stage 3 Knowledge Transfer: technical package, process documents, analytical methods

blocks.zh: Stages 4–6：設備確認、PPQ、法規申報、Handover
blocks.en: Stages 4–6: equipment qualification, PPQ, regulatory filing, Handover
